name: Vol'jin's Blessing must not rewrite Big Bad Voodoo's amounts (#7788 tooltips)
contract: Vol'jin's Blessing 706577 is a passive family-19 aura carrying one SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER effect with op SPELLMOD_EFFECT2, base +20 and an empty class mask, and SpellAffect.dbc names no targets for it.

SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod falls through to IsAffected(19, empty mask), which matches every family-19 spell, so the +20 lands on effect index 1 of all Witch Doctor spells while the talent's documented behavior (Shadow Avatar shortening Spirit Glaive's cooldown) lives in script and needs no modifier.

On a Witch Doctor carrying Vol'jin's Blessing the field 802718 read -30% damage dealt instead of -50%, and the ally aura 802719 read 0% damage taken instead of -20%, while the spellbook still promises 50% and 20%: the buff tooltips faithfully reported corrupted gameplay.
AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp therefore neutralizes Vol'jin's Blessing's modifier effect, so Big Bad Voodoo keeps its -50% damage, -50% healing and -20% ally protection with the talent learned.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Vol'jin's Blessing applies its passive aura on learn
Vol'jin's Blessing leaves the field's damage-dealt slot at -50%
Vol'jin's Blessing leaves the field's healing-done slot at -50%
Vol'jin's Blessing leaves the ally damage-taken slot at -20%
Let the spirit apply its field
The Witch Doctor receives the field from the spirit
The field still reduces damage dealt by 50% with Vol'jin's Blessing learned
The field still reduces healing done by 50% with Vol'jin's Blessing learned
